name: Jehoiada
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Joab was over all the host of Israel, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the Cherethites and the Pelethites. Adoram was over the tribute, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder, and Sheva was scribe.

Abishai the brother of Joab was chief among the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them and had a name among the three, and was their captain, but he attained not unto the first three. Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did many acts: he slew two lionlike men of Moab, went down and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow, and slew a goodly Egyptian with the Egyptian's own spear after plucking it out of his hand with a staff.

note.label: 2 Samuel 23: The Last Words of David and His Mighty Men

points: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a valiant man of many acts, slew two lionlike men of Moab, went down and slew a lion in a pit on a snowy day, and killed an Egyptian five cubits high.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 11: David Anointed and His Mighty Men

points: The Levites are named here, for Jehoiada led the Aaronites, the sons of Aaron, and Zadok also was a Levite.
